Description: Resample the time-resolution by averaging over every ``n`` snapshots

Apply time series segmentation with `tsam <https://tsam.readthedocs.io/en/latest/index.html>`_ package to ``n`` adjacent snapshots of varying lengths based on capacity factors of varying renewables  hydro inflow and load.

Add regional carbon-dioxide emissions limits configured in ``electricity: regional_Co2_limits``. These can be specified in the file linked at ``electricity: regional_Co2_limits`` in the configuration. File defaults to ``repo_data/regional_co2_limits.csv``.

Add Renewable Portfolio Standard (RPS) constraints to shares of generator production (MWh) per carrier for individual countries. Standards can be set for single carriers or groups of carriers. Each constraint can be designated for a specified planning horizon in multi-period models. Opts and path for portfolio_standards.csv must be defined

Adds Energy Reserve Margin (ERM) constraints. Requires a second feasible network state at every snapshot which balances at every bus and, summed over each region, serves that region's demand times ``1 + erm``. The reserve state obeys the same operational envelope and Kirchhoff voltage law as the base state, so inter-regional transmission and SSSC redispatch contribute to adequacy and storage contributions are energy-backed. One shared reserve state satisfies every region's requirement at once. Defaults to 15% reserve margin for all regions if not specified in config.
Add minimum or maximum levels of generator nominal capacity per carrier(s), per region(s), per investment horizon. Opts and path for technology_capacity_targets.csv must be defined

Add an overall absolute gas limit. If configured in ``electricity: gaslimit`` it is given in MWh thermal, if a float is appended, the overall gaslimit is assumed to be given in TWh thermal (e.g. ``CH4L200`` limits gas dispatch to 200 TWh termal)
